findings.rationale: parse_kernel_source_with_bounds validates direct-spec override keys against declarations but only writes overrides into pre-existing VerifyBounds entries. A declared entity or number lacking such an entry therefore passes validation while the requested override is silently ignored. Business and requirements documents omit key validation entirely, so misspelled or absent keys are also accepted without effect. Callers such as the sweep driver can consequently believe a requested scope was tested when the original bounds were used.
